top_signals.title: India's Central Bank Hikes Repo Rate by 25 Bps
top_signals.summary:
RBI raised interest rates for the first time in nearly four years. Governor Sanjay Malhotra says given the current economic scenario, rate hikes are off the table in the near-term.

(Corrects to remove incorrect name strap at 00:50:28.) (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Former Whitbread bosses buy back dozens of Beefeater restaurants
top_signals.summary: Former senior managers at Whitbread have led a deal to buy back nearly 60 restaurants from the group, after it wound up its Beefeater and Brewers Fayre chains last month. Common Table Group, a British hospitality firm, has agreed to buy 57 restaurant sites and one Premier Inn hotel from the FTSE 100 hotels giant.  [...]
